reviews.text: As always they were exceptional in taking care of my cat who is the worst patient. By the next day she was back to normal.

I wouldn't even consider going anywhere else - these guys absolutely rock. Kodak has been to 3 locations. Each time, the professional, knowledgeable and courteous staff go above and beyond to take care of her and assuage me of any concerns. The offices are immaculate. The lengths they go to, (particularly under Covid time) to make the visit comfortable and fun are truly outstanding. Kudos to the entire team!
Lovely staff, everyone is polite, knowledgeable and the clinic is nice. Definitely recommend for your fur babies 🙌🏼

I had a great experience with Dr. Lee and Ashley at Veterinary Care Group. They were incredibly receptive to all of my questions and took the time to thoroughly answer and clarify every concern I had, while also making sure to communicate any concerns they had about my dog.

I also really appreciated how they involved us parents and made the experience as stress-free as possible for our dog during the procedures she needed. Their patience, communication, and genuine care really stood out. Thank you, Dr. Lee and Ashley!

Dr. Shelson is quite literally the best veterinarian we've seen ever! She is sooo nice and very understanding. We have two anxious kitties and she was so understanding throughout the whole process and trying to find a way to help them get to the vet without being so afraid. She also played calming music throughout the whole visit. It's so refreshing to have someone so knowledgeable and passionate.

The staff here are also very friendly. They remodeled recently and it looks better than it has in the past! Thank you all for everything!!

They are great ! And patient ! My frenchie Rosie had such a bad experience in her last vet . Rosie can be such a fuss but they handled it with so much care . Even offered a frenchie muzzle . Thank you so much !

I love this hospital. Every time we visit New York for the holidays, we make it a point to bring our crazy pup to this location—and for good reason! Dr. Lee, Manager Bernadette, and the entire team always welcome us with so much kindness and patience. For someone who’s had dogs for over 20 years it feels nice to be cared for even with a new puppy. Thank you to this amazing team for going above and beyond. We truly appreciate you and couldn’t imagine trusting anyone else with our pup while we’re in NYC!

May 2026: Dr. Lee continues to be incredibly compassionate, knowledgeable, and takes the time to thoroughly explain everything, which gives me great confidence in my dog’s care. Bernadette, the manager, always takes exceptional care of us. Joyce is also wonderful—friendly, attentive, and genuinely caring. The entire staff is professional, kind, and dedicated, something hard to find in a lot of vet clinics. The hospital is newly renovated and looks beautiful, clean, and welcoming. I am so grateful for everyone at Forest Hills Veterinary Care and highly recommend anyone looking for a great vet clinic.
Hello GZ Tian, please give us a call so we can hear about your experience and what we can do to improve.
Professional and knowledgeable staff!  Clean and welcoming environment!  Highly recommended!  They took excellent care of my pet and advised me on how to best support my pet's health.
Thank you for the star rating!

Very professional and patient. Answered all my questions. Did not rush and took the time with my anxious cat. They ordered something for his anxiety before I brought him in and made a good experience.

First time here with my fur baby. Dr. Lee and Joyce are beyond knowledgable. I felt so safe and comfortable and at ease knowing my dog will get the care she needs. I didn’t feel forced nor pressured into the services they were providing. They made sure both my fur baby and I were comfortable and I definitely had a peace of mind going home after having an amazing experience. The staff members are so friendly.
Due to having a lot of services that my fur baby needed, I wanted her to get a full check up, bloodwork, fecal, urine and up to date shots. Also, she needed medicine for her ear which I had to take home. So if you’re wondering about pricing it was definitely reasonable for which was $855. Now keep in mind a lot of services was done on my dog which I had agreed on. For the sake of my baby I want her to live a long healthy life since she is a young senior. Again, no one forced me into these services. I wanted her to get a full check up and get tested for a current health record. Previous vet places I’ve been too never did a full check up on my girl besides giving shots and etc… So I am beyond pleased and so satisfied bringing my dog to this vet.

Great first experience! Dr Shelson was patient very nice and answered all my questions, the follow up with a call to check for any symptoms after the vaccine shot! Very happy with my first appointment.
thank you for the rating!

We went for our first well-visit with our first furry baby. From start to finish we were greeted with warmth and affection. They answered all of our questions with pleasure. We felt welcomed and appreciated.

Dr. Shelson  and all the staff are very nice and accommodating. Dr. Shelson and her associate was very patient in calming my dog so she can proceed with the examination. She explained thoroughly what my dog needed( annual shots, dental) . She took her time , I did not feel rushed. I will definitely continue to bring my dog to this office, since my previous vet office closed.

I have a difficult pet, and Dr Lee along with our nurse or technician did an excellent job.  Plus, the costs were fair - I would say low for the neighborhood.  Overall, a very professional and friendly team.
Very helpful and kind, I brought my cat in to make sure she has everything necessary. But now I will most definitely also bring my dog here

Forest Hills Veterinary Care has been nothing short of amazing. The staff is always friendly, welcoming, and genuinely caring every time we walk through the door.

A special thank‑you to Dr. Shelson and Dr. Lee, who consistently meet and exceed our expectations. They’ve taken incredible care of our fur babies over the years: Sammy (RIP), Petey, and Toby. Their compassion, professionalism, and dedication mean more than words can express.

I really appreciate that they made some room for me in an urgent case of a sick-kitty, making a spot for me to come in even on a busy pre-holiday day.  The vet-techs were all really great, and when any of them were out of their depth with a tricky cat or process they had backups ready to take over.  Radically better experience for me and the kitty both, than what we had at the previous "cat hospital" in Forest Hills. I am grateful for the help from these friendly and  knowledgable folks.   Fingers crossed he keeps getting better, but Im grateful to have found a spot to take him to if he needs.
Brought my Yorkie in for a dental consultation.  My pockets are not gonna be happy with the procedure buthave to get it done for his sake.
Love, love this veterinary office in forest hills. They take very good care of my dog, Tito. Employees and doctors are so polite, friendly and very helpful.

For context, I've been coming here for 5 years, no issue. Recently, I brought my dog for a check-up.  When it was time to pay, my card was declined.  After several attempts, both using their machine and manually inputting my card, I asked the secretary what we can do as I didn't have cash and my account didn't appear to have an issue. She told me if I didn't pay at the time of my visit, I would be sent to collections. I told her that was a bit extreme, granted I've been going there for years and this has never happened. She suggested I contact my bank and even the bank representative mentioned it had to be an error with their payment system because my account was in good standing and there wasn't any sort of lock on my account. Again my card continued to decline, so I asked if they could invoice me and they told me they don't do invoices...what kind of medical establishment doesn't send a bill or invoice? Additionally, they mentioned I go out in the freezing cold with my dog (who just got two vaccines) to go to an ATM (so I have to now pay cash to take out cash) and I said no. After speaking to the manager, she told me they'd do me a "favor" by letting me come in the next day by 9am  (no later) to pay in cash to avoid being reported to collections. Imagine threatening someone who has come in for 5 years and always paid on time to be sent to collections when it was an error with their system and literally the day of. The manager and secretary are extremely unprofessional and tone deaf. I came the next day by 9am to drop off the cash and was met with more disrespectful behavior, as the manager proceeded to tell me I had insufficient funds, which wasn't valid, their system had an error. The amount of manipulation (having to pay by the next morning to avoid collections), gaslighting and passive aggressiveness is unacceptable and unethical. They were literally threatening me.  Nobody should ever have to endure this kind of treatment and there seems to be multiple issues with management. Using scare tactics such as sending me to collections is an empty threat and I am now going elsewhere.
